from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486287/attempts/1eb91fd6574841ae8e00d1bb94d07e69/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-71e91a32.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value in (2, 8):
                height = 5 if value == 2 else 4
                top = max(0, r - height + 1)
                for rr in range(top, r):
                    out[rr][c] = 1
                out[top][c] = value
    return out
'''

ns={}

transform=ns['transform']
